title: What placebos can and can't do

probes.question: Which of these can make people seem better after a placebo without the placebo doing anything?
True or false: in an open-label placebo, patients are not told the treatment is inert.

image.alt: Many small beige and pink tablets arranged in a grid on a white plate on a wooden table.

body.claim: Placebos can change how pain and nausea feel, but they generally have no important clinical effects otherwise.
body.why: Modern studies find placebos can affect outcomes such as pain and nausea, but generally have no important clinical effects otherwise. Some improvement after a placebo is due to other factors, such as regression to the mean. In open-label placebos, patients know the pill is inert, and trials found possible benefits over no treatment, but the trials were small and need cautious reading.
